caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular swatches of patterned textile, each fragment featuring a design dominated by swirling, floral-like shapes. Both swatches are rendered with a color palette consisting primarily of reds, browns, and beiges, with accents of blue and green interspersed throughout the designs. The upper swatch displays a prominent central red swirl or flower with brown shadowing and surrounding beige and red ornamental patterns, including small blue flower details near the top right. The lower swatch contains a larger area of red swirling forms intermixed with darker brown elements and beige background motifs, with hints of green and blue at the top left. The texture of each swatch appears velvety or ribbed, with the patterns presented in a painterly manner to mimic the textile’s texture. Both textile fragments are placed vertically one above the other on a plain, off-white background. Handwritten notes and measurements appear near each swatch: “11 1/2 by 7 1/2” next to the upper one, “13 by 11” near the lower, and the name “Mary Bonner” at the bottom right.
title: Machine Woven Carpet Bag
